dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform medium-grey skin tone across the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light-grey patches localized on the right lateral margin and posterior third.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; tonal gradients lack sharp edges or high-contrast borders.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast light-colored circular spots on the right lateral flank and sparse dark punctate specks along the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, longitudinal linear marks visible on the posterior portion of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, elongated dorsal ridge along the posterior midline and visible blowhole at the anterior apex.
